peers.name: deploy-to-vercel
peers.description: Deploy applications and websites to Vercel. Use when the user requests deployment actions like "deploy my app", "deploy and give me the link", "push this live", or "create a preview deployment".

en.tagline: Checks UI code against Web Interface Guidelines
en.summary: Reviews UI code for compliance with the Web Interface Guidelines. It reads a rule file bundled with the skill, checks the files you name, and reports findings as terse file:line entries. Use it for a fast compliance pass on accessibility, design, or UX.
problem: Checking UI code against a set of interface rules usually means reading the rules and the code by hand. It is easy to miss items, and the results are hard to compare across files.
With this skill, the rules come from one pinned snapshot in the skill folder. The review runs against that snapshot and returns findings in one consistent file:line format.
fit: Reviewing UI files for accessibility problems before a merge
Auditing a page or component for design or UX issues
Checking a site against the bundled Web Interface Guidelines
unfit: Reviewing with no files or pattern, since the skill asks for them first
Checking against rules other than the bundled guidelines, because it does not fetch rules from the network
steps: The skill reads the bundled rules from `references/command.md`.
It reads the files or pattern you specify, or asks you which files to review if you give none.
It checks the code against all rules in the guidelines.
It outputs findings in the terse `file:line` format defined in the guidelines.

zh.tagline: 按 Web 界面指南检查 UI 代码
zh.summary: 按 Web 界面指南检查 UI 代码是否合规。它读取技能目录中打包的规则文件，检查你指定的文件，并以简洁的 file:line 格式列出问题。适合快速检查无障碍、设计或用户体验方面的问题。
problem: 按界面规则检查 UI 代码，通常要人工逐条对照规则和代码。容易漏项，不同文件之间的结果也难以比较。
使用这个技能后，规则来自技能目录中固定版本的快照。审查基于该快照进行，结果统一按 file:line 格式返回。
fit: 合并前检查 UI 文件的无障碍问题
审计页面或组件的设计与用户体验问题
按打包的 Web 界面指南检查网站
unfit: 没有提供文件或匹配模式时，因为技能会先要求指定文件
需要依据打包指南以外的规则检查，因为它不会从网络获取规则
steps: 技能从 `references/command.md` 读取打包的规则。
它读取你指定的文件或匹配模式；如果你没有指定，它会询问要审查哪些文件。
它按指南中的全部规则检查代码。
它按指南定义的简洁 `file:line` 格式输出问题。
